label: PF Backlog 583
title: Eventing SSOT: migrate existing consumers (event_bus/context/ops/capabilities/parked/notifications/alerts) behind shims
body:
## Problem / why
Multiple bespoke subscriber/alert mechanisms must move onto the shared bus without breaking callers.

## Goal / value
Migrate each consumer to the subscriber/transport API with a compatibility shim so behavior is identical
during migration, then remove shims.

## In scope
- event_bus.on/emit -> registry (shim); orchestration_context.route -> alert-policy consumer;
  ops_phase/pipeline_capabilities/parked_review -> subscriber API; notification_system/alerts -> transports.

## Out of scope
- Deleting the frozen dashboard websocket (E11); new consumers.

## Acceptance criteria
- Each migrated consumer behaves identically; test_event_ssot + related tests green; upstream callers unchanged.

## Verification / test plan
- Per-consumer regression tests; wired_audit green.

## Dependencies & links
- E4, E5, E6.
